reviews.review:
GET RID OF THE INVINCIBLE REAPER WORM (AND THE BOSSES SHOULDN'T BE INVINCIBLE EITHER)! 

It isn't fun to be instantly killed because you wanted to explore the map and collect all the things! 

More enemies spawn? Sure, give me the challenge! The enemies deal more damage? That's fair, I'll take the risk! Invincible instant death worm that punishes you for exploring? NO! That sucks so bad!

I cannot in good conscience recommend this to anyone, and I gave it an honest effort, ascended each of the characters and completed all the missions for max clearance level. The game just isn't as good as other GSG titles or other roguelike/roguelites. The balancing is atrocious and when I beat hard encounters I wasn't satisfied, I was frustrated that I was even put through that unfair fight. I must admit I did enjoy the jumble mode, but you have to get to clearance level 8 just to unlock it. A game's enjoyment shouldn't be so conditional, where one specific game mode is good.

All the criers wanted a DRG 2 and got something different that LOOKS like DRG.
It's different. And it's good that it's different. I wish it wasn't, because I enjoyed the elements that made DRG great. I enjoy RC as well (maybe not as much but still do). 
Most importantly, I want to give the devs a chance.

I give a thumb up out of the need to balance a bit on the negatives and to first and foremost reassert that this game still has the EA excuse for the time being. Give it time, it will get better just as the original DRG did.

We already have a clean game experience with next to zero bug, 4 new classes of dwarves , each very fun to play, lots of new wacky voicelines, a fine Roguelike feature coming with the satisfaction of an OP build and indecent DPS by the end of the run, although it can get a bit antagonistic at times when picking perks and weapons without speaking to your team mates

BUT, I nonetheless have to agree with the current downsides who's been pointed out. For a 30$ at launch, the current content is very much lacking in content in the main course of a run. I mean, every floor plays the same way with the exact same objective : find the elevator, defend the elevator.  
And at the end of it, a boss picked among 3.
This is like having a single type of mission in DRG. 
It begs for twists, different main objectives and such. Even the main timer a la Risk of Rain needs more refining (and nerf)

I'm confident it will get better, and I'm having a blast with my pals, but don't get it if you expect the same content depth as DRG. Right now they're only scratching the surface

I've promoted my guardian to 3 stars, and i'm trying to enjoy this game, but the Game dev's Are doing a Great job of stoping that rn.
peak rock and stone game! Ram rod REALLY rocks!!!

after the most recent balance changes i think its safe to say that the developers are fully unsure what to do with the balancing of the game. Bosses feel extremely powerful and i tend not to deal enough damage nor have enough ammo to deal with the enemies that spawn during the bosses, especially with their new invincibility phases. i like what the game has in it and the upgrades are very fun along with the build variety, but i think right now its better not to buy the game until they get a grip on what they are doing. I love deep rock galactic and i also love roguelikes, but this isn't fun right now.
No idea why the reviews are so bad, the game is awesome. More Borderlands than DRG but with the same  fluidity, gunplay and atmosphere.

Honestly an incredible experience that streamlines the combat / build experience of Deep Rock!

I love so much of the changes this team has made in order to convert the existing systems into a rogue like. From the worms to the depths to the upgrade systems it all feels well though out and comes together for a fun and MUCH faster paced experience. 

There's some balance and stability issues but it's an early access game, I think it's CRAZY to be leaving "do not recommend" reviews at this point. The issues are minor and expected given the clearly communicated state of development it's in. 

I'd love to see some more customization and unlocks down the road! Maybe some class specific quest to unlock alternate secondary abilities? 

Anyways, if you can handle some mostly minor issues this game is great and I'd highly recommend it as one of the most fun multiplayer rogue like experiences out there

all in all, it COULD become a great game, but for now, many things to work on as mentioned in several comments. Guns, perks, etc all don't feel great, I don't feel stronger at the last stage as when I start. Some weapons are really bad, all the runs feel the same regardless of the map. Having a countdown makes sense but having non damagable worms are nonsense, also having a spawn of enemies while the boss battle starts  is bs. I understand its a beta but still, expected more considering how much the developers have learned from DRG. I'll keep an eye the next few months but seeing the latest update they made, focusing on the wrong things..
Great game, glad it's not a DRG 2 (which is very boring). Lacks variety for now but that's gonna improve with time.
The devs have lost their touch, this game is DRG in the name only but it's not made for DRG fans, can't agree with the decisions they make during its development.
